yaml.pagetitle: Vish Sridhara, PhD | Bioinformatics Solutions Architect

markdown.markdown:
I design data and AI solutions that help science-driven and regulated-health organizations turn complex data into dependable,
decision-ready outcomes. With 10+ years across biotech, consulting and federal organizations, including NIH and FDA, I cover the full
data lifecycle, from ingestion and quality control to analytics and delivery.  

My roots in engineering and computational sciences let me work with both the scientists asking the questions and the engineers building the platforms that answer them.  

## What I do

- **Solution architecture:** end-to-end genomics data platforms and pipelines, from ingestion and QC to analytics and delivery (Nextflow, Snakemake, Databricks, ETL/ELT, orchestration).
- **Cloud:** AWS (S3, EC2) and Azure (Data Factory, Databricks), with Docker and CI/CD for reproducible deployment.
- **Applied AI/ML:** PyTorch, TensorFlow, and MLflow, including protein language models such as ESM-2 on antibody data.
- **Life sciences:** bulk and single-cell RNA-seq, antibody repertoires, multi-omics, and regulated NIH/FDA data environments.  
  
## Selected experience

- **Senior Bioinformatics Scientist, Argentys Informatics:** reproducible pipeline for antibody repertoire analysis on the Observed Antibody Space (2B+ sequences, about 3 TB), producing model-ready data for protein language models.
- **Bioinformatics Scientist (contract), Twist Bioscience:** zero-shot antibody fitness and developability inference with repeatable evaluation.
- **Senior Bioinformatics Scientist (contract), FDA:** bulk and single-cell RNA-seq pipelines.

Full history on my [CV](/cv/).

## Open-source work

- [**OAS-wrapper**](https://pypi.org/project/OAS-wrapper/) (Python, PyPI): parse, annotate and align Observed Antibody Space data. [Source](https://github.com/sridhara-omics/OAS_wrapper)
- [**scPipeline**](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=scPipeline) (R, CRAN): single-cell annotation, markers and pathway analysis. [Source](https://github.com/sridhara-omics/scPipeline)
- [**ProteinLMs**](https://github.com/sridhara-omics/ProteinLMs): notebooks and a Nextflow workflow for understanding protein language models.

## Writing and recognition

My [blog](/year-archive/) has practical notes on bioinformatics, single-cell analysis, proteomics and machine learning for biology; a good
start is [Understanding ESM model and architecture](https://sridhara-omics.github.io/genomics/Understanding-ESM-model-and-architecture-Beginner/).
I have 20+ peer-reviewed publications, 1,000+ citations and an h-index of 15 ([Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=6rYid2YAAAAJ&hl=en)).

## Education and credentials

PhD and MS in Electrical and Computer Engineering (Old Dominion University); 
NIH postdoctoral fellow in Bioinformatics.
PyTorch for Deep Learning Professional Certificate (DeepLearning.AI, 2026).

## Let's connect

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/viswanadham-sridhara-308263174/) | [GitHub](https://github.com/sridhara-omics) | [CV](/cv/)

*Views on this site are my own and do not represent any employer or agency.*
